decisions.decision: Classify the seven residual answer directories as unmanaged legacy static HTML, not automatically as manually authored or deletable pages.
decisions.basis: Their paths are absent from both the two explicit build_pages page() routes and six literal EXTRA_ANSWERS entries, while Git history records their separate additions.

decisions.decision: Treat first/last commit provenance as repository history, not proof of the process that rendered each HTML file.
decisions.basis: The relevant commits do not consistently contain a corresponding builder source registration.

decisions.decision: Keep the seven pages visible in the sitemap inventory but absent from llms.txt as a recorded mismatch, not an automatic recommendation to add them.
decisions.basis: The current sitemap recursively includes index.html while _write_llms enumerates only hardcoded and data-driven generator slugs.

decisions.decision: Treat 2026-11-15 sitemap lastmod as a global build date, not page-level freshness.
decisions.basis: _write_sitemap inserts one UPDATED value into every URL entry; last known legacy file changes predate this global date.

decisions.decision: Do not remove, rewrite, redirect, publish or deploy any legacy URL in this run.
decisions.basis: Those actions affect public-facing GEO outputs and require an explicit owner decision; current commercial terms are also not freshly confirmed.
